subject: input string 9 is invalid in this locale

messages.author: 120aaddd58a60b60
messages.subject: input string 9 is invalid in this locale
parts:
Hello,

I'm receiving the following error message in my logs

Error in gsub("&", "&amp ", result, fixed = TRUE) :
  input string 9 is invalid in this locale
Error in gsub("&", "&amp ", result, fixed = TRUE) :
  input string 9 is invalid in this locale

I suspect I have some non-latin characters in my tables that I try to display. When I see this table in RStudio (e.g. with viewData()) it shows some question-mark-in-a-black-diamond symbols in place of non-latin characters, but otherwise R processes the data just fine.

I'm not really familiar with how to handle unicode with R etc. - could someone please provide a pointer on where to start?

Thank you for your time,
Victor
